goal: Reduce false breakouts (losing positions whose max favourable excursion stayed < 0.3R) without choking winners.
bench: high_cagr/fb_harness.py (frozen). Baseline = deployed research config: 15 symbols, 6 slots, R=0.75%, 4B + V2 + BTC-regime gate. Baseline full 2021-10-05..2026-10-05 @2bps: CAGR 44.89%, DD 36.71%, Calmar 1.223; false breakouts 535 positions, -$82,988.
method_form: entry filter only: a causal boolean mask over signal bars (can only remove signals; also blocks pyramid adds at that bar). Each method has exactly the two variants below; no other variant may be added or reported as a result.

close_location.idea: Breakout bar must close near its extreme (strong close = real demand).

confirmation.idea: Require the breakout to hold or to penetrate clearly.
confirmation.A: previous closed bar ALSO closed beyond its own Donchian-10 level and the 4h Kumo in the same direction (2 consecutive breakout closes)
confirmation.B: close beyond max(donchian_high_10, kumo_top) (long) / below min(donchian_low_10, kumo_bottom) (short) by >= 0.25 ATR

volume.A: signal-bar volume >= 1.2 x mean volume of the previous 20 closed bars

squeeze.idea: Breakouts out of volatility compression are more reliable.
squeeze.A: range of the 20 bars BEFORE the signal bar (max high - min low) divided by ATR, ranked against its own previous 250 values, percentile <= 50%

adx.idea: Only trade breakouts when a trend is already present.
adx.A: Wilder ADX(14) on 4h at the signal bar >= 20 (use lbank_bot.adx_wilder)

bar_shape.idea: Avoid exhaustion bars / require decisive bars.
bar_shape.B: body |close-open| >= 50% of range AND bar closes in the trade direction

htf_trend.A: last COMPLETED UTC day: daily close above (long) / below (short) daily EMA20 AND daily EMA20 higher (lower) than 5 completed days earlier
htf_trend.B: 4h close above (long) / below (short) the midpoint of the 100-bar high-low range

breadth.idea: Breakouts are more reliable when the market moves together.
breadth.A: >= 2 OTHER symbols had a same-direction signal within the last 6 signal bars (24h, current bar included)

false_breakout_metric: positions with net < 0 and MFE < 0.3R, full period @2bps
pass_gate (all must hold): @2bps and @5bps: Calmar >= baseline in BOTH H1 and H2
Calmar not worse than baseline on BOTH the old-5 and the new-10 universes (4 slots, @2bps, full)
multiple_testing: 16 candidates. Any pass is in-sample evidence on the period where V2/B were found; a pass would still need forward paper data before going live.
decision: Results only; nothing is changed in the bot without the user's confirmation.
